meta.task: Build me a checkout page for an online store

issues: unmirrored: Checkout: Order Summary Panel -> Checkout: Delivery Method Selector

defs.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper Header
defs.genInstructions: Build a horizontal step indicator across the top showing Cart → Shipping → Payment → Review with completion states, clickable steps, and a secure-checkout trust badge row. It orients the user and lets them jump back to completed sections.
defs.role: The navigational spine of the checkout that tracks and switches which section of the flow the user is editing.

effectors.name: Checkout: Shipping Address Form
effectors.description: When the address form passes validation on 'Continue', it emits a stepComplete('shipping') event; the stepper marks the Shipping step complete with a checkmark and advances the active step to Payment.

effectors.name: Checkout: Payment Method Panel
effectors.description: When card/wallet details validate successfully, the panel emits stepComplete('payment'); the stepper marks Payment complete and advances the active step to Review.

effectors.name: Checkout: Place Order Action Bar
effectors.description: On successful order submission the action bar emits orderPlaced; the stepper marks all steps complete and locks further navigation.

targets.name: Checkout: Shipping Address Form
targets.description: Clicking the 'Shipping' step emits activeStep='shipping'; the address form expands into edit mode, scrolls into view, and focuses its first field while other sections collapse to summary rows.

targets.name: Checkout: Payment Method Panel
targets.description: Clicking the 'Payment' step emits activeStep='payment'; the payment panel expands to edit mode and focuses the card number field, collapsing when another step becomes active.

defs.name: Checkout: Shipping Address Form
defs.genInstructions: Build a two-column form with contact email, full name, street address with autocomplete, apt line, city, state/region select, postal code, country select, phone, plus saved-address cards, 'billing same as shipping' toggle, and inline validation. It captures where the order ships.
defs.role: The data-entry section that captures the destination and contact details that drive shipping options, tax, and the final order payload.

effectors.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper Header
effectors.description: Receives activeStep='shipping' and expands into editable mode with first field focused; collapses to a one-line summary when another step is active.

targets.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper Header
targets.description: On valid submit, emits stepComplete('shipping') so the stepper checks off Shipping and advances to Payment.

targets.name: Checkout: Delivery Method Selector
targets.description: On country/state/postal code change (debounced, once valid), emits the destination object; the selector re-queries carrier rates and re-renders available delivery options with updated prices and ETA dates, deselecting any option no longer offered.

targets.name: Checkout: Order Summary Panel
targets.description: Emits the destination postal code/country so the summary recalculates estimated sales tax/VAT and updates the tax line and grand total.

targets.name: Checkout: Payment Method Panel
targets.description: When 'billing same as shipping' is toggled on, pushes the full address object to prefill and hide the billing address fields; toggling off clears and reveals them.

defs.name: Checkout: Delivery Method Selector
defs.genInstructions: Build a list of selectable radio cards for shipping speeds (Standard, Express, Overnight, Store Pickup) each with carrier, price, and estimated delivery date, plus a gift-options and delivery-instructions field. It lets the user choose how fast the order arrives.
defs.role: The section where the user picks a shipping speed, feeding its cost into the totals and its ETA into the order.

effectors.name: Checkout: Shipping Address Form
effectors.description: Receives the validated destination address; re-fetches carrier rates and re-renders the option cards with new prices and ETA dates, clearing selections that are unavailable for that region.

targets.name: Checkout: Order Summary Panel
targets.description: On option select, emits {methodId, label, cost, eta}; the summary updates its Shipping line item, the ETA note, and recomputes the grand total.

targets.name: Checkout: Place Order Action Bar
targets.description: Emits selection-valid state; the action bar only enables the Place Order button once a delivery method is chosen, and displays the chosen ETA in its microcopy.

defs.name: Checkout: Payment Method Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a payment section with tabs for Card, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Buy-Now-Pay-Later, a formatted card number/expiry/CVC form with live card-brand detection and a card preview, saved cards list, billing address block, and save-card checkbox. It collects how the order is paid.
defs.role: The section that captures and validates the payment instrument and billing details required to authorize the order.

effectors.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper Header
effectors.description: Receives activeStep='payment' and expands to edit mode with the card number field focused.

effectors.name: Checkout: Shipping Address Form
effectors.description: When 'billing same as shipping' is on, receives the address object and prefills/hides the billing address block; on toggle-off it clears and reveals the fields.

targets.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper Header
targets.description: On successful validation of the selected payment method, emits stepComplete('payment') so the stepper checks off Payment and advances to Review.

targets.name: Checkout: Place Order Action Bar
targets.description: Emits paymentReady(true/false) plus the method label and last-4; the action bar enables/disables the Place Order button and renders 'Paying with Visa ••••4242'.

defs.name: Checkout: Order Summary Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a sticky right-rail summary listing each cart line item with thumbnail, variant, quantity stepper and remove action, plus subtotal, discount, shipping, tax and grand total rows and an editable promo/gift-card input. It shows exactly what is being bought and what it costs.
defs.role: The always-visible ledger of cart contents and money math that every other section updates and the order action submits.

effectors.name: Checkout: Shipping Address Form
effectors.description: Receives destination postal code/country and recalculates the estimated tax line and grand total.

effectors.name: Checkout: Delivery Method Selector
effectors.description: Receives the chosen {methodId, cost, eta} and updates the Shipping cost line, ETA note, and grand total.

targets.name: Checkout: Place Order Action Bar
targets.description: Emits the live grand total, item count, and cart-empty flag; the action bar renders the total on the button ('Pay $128.40'), and disables itself if the cart becomes empty.

targets.name: Checkout: Delivery Method Selector
targets.description: When line items change (quantity edit or removal), emits updated cart weight/value so shipping options requote and free-shipping-threshold eligibility is re-evaluated.

defs.name: Checkout: Place Order Action Bar
defs.genInstructions: Build a prominent bottom action bar with the primary Place Order button showing the live total, a terms-and-conditions acknowledgement checkbox, payment/ETA microcopy, processing spinner state, and error/success messaging. It is the final commit step.
defs.role: The terminal commit control that gathers readiness signals from every section and submits the order.

effectors.name: Checkout: Order Summary Panel
effectors.description: Receives the live grand total, item count and cart-empty flag; renders the amount inside the button label and disables itself when the cart is empty.

effectors.name: Checkout: Payment Method Panel
effectors.description: Receives paymentReady boolean plus method label and last-4; enables the button only when true and shows 'Paying with Visa ••••4242'.

effectors.name: Checkout: Delivery Method Selector
effectors.description: Receives the selected delivery method validity and ETA; button stays disabled until a method is selected, and the ETA is shown as microcopy above it.

targets.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper Header
targets.description: On successful submission emits orderPlaced; the stepper marks all steps complete and locks navigation.
